scroll_effects.name: nav background transparent to deep violet

motion.evidence: Framer-built; 0 @keyframes (all motion JS-driven). 88 IntersectionObservers / 88 targets, many with dense scrub arrays [0,0.01,…,0.99]; 2467 rAF calls per scroll pass; 10 scroll + 6 mousemove listeners; 5 cursor-followers; 21 marquees; 83 draggable; 1 pinned (fixed) el; 1 nav background-shift (rgba(0,0,0,0)→rgb(40,15,98)); 18 transform/parallax, 11 fade-in, 9 opacity, 6 filter(blur/brightness), 2 scale(0.88↔0.94) effects. respectsReducedMotion=false, 0 PRM rules, focus_visible=false. Corroborated against frames s00/s03/s05/s06/s08/s09 (corpus/production/screenshots/pitch-com/frames/).

notes: Single-hue value system normalized from raw tallies, trusting the frames over the profile. Violet #5318eb is brand/action; deep band #280f62 and near-black indigo #0c021c are darker values of the same hue (raw rgb(12,2,28)/rgb(40,15,98)/rgb(83,24,235)); washes #ebe3fe/#c6a5ff. The ONE non-violet design color is the lime CTA #c4ee87 (rgb(196,238,135)), hover→lilac #c6aafa (rgb(198,170,250)). The blue rgb(0,0,238)/#0000ee with 114 hits is the UA default link/border color on unstyled anchors — treated as capture noise, recorded under roles.link-default-ua, NOT a real palette color. Type: families normalized to Eina 03 (display/UI) + Mark Pro Bold (heavy display) + Space Mono (eyebrow/mono); the 'sans-serif' tally (1017) and weight 400 (1215) are Framer placeholder/fallback noise — real display is bold. Two-tier scale with an intentional void: body 12/16/20 + display 28/32/48/64/92/180 (px → rem); the dominant 12px body and 180px H1 are both confirmed in craft.layout. Tracking is a per-size negative token (−0.32px@16 → −7.2px@180): ~−0.02em across body/mid-display, tightening to −0.04em only at the 180px hero, with the 92px step (−0.2px ≈ −0.002em) a deliberate near-zero outlier. Radius 20px is dominant; large radii throughout. Single tinted shadow + matching radial glow (craft.elevation). Motion fields evidence-backed (see motion.evidence); reduced-motion NOT respected and focus-visible NOT styled are flagged as a11y defects to fix on any rebuild.
